pitch.oneLiner: Guard merchant convoys through a contested strait: tap to intercept drones, missiles and jets before they hit.
pitch.audience: Strategy and arcade players who like Missile Command, tower defense and roguelite runs, in short landscape sessions.
pitch.coreLoop: Choose a map and one Armory upgrade per bay, defend ten waves by tapping threats, grab weapon drops and fire them, draft a weapon after each wave, and win Armory cards for the next run.
pitch.differentiator: Twenty hand-built maps that each add one idea, twelve weapons that each answer a kind of attack, fully offline with no ads.

features.title: Tap to intercept
features.description: Ships cross the strait left to right while drones, ballistic and guided missiles, jets and boats attack from the shore. Tap a threat to fire the carrier's gun at it; a rack of rounds reloads over time. Losing too many ships ends the run.
acceptance: A tap fires an interceptor at the threat or point tapped
An empty rack dry-clicks until it reloads
Ships lost are counted in the HUD; the run ends at the loss limit
Ten waves clear a map

features.title: 20 maps in four chapters
features.description: Home Waters, The Narrows, Dark Water and Open War: five maps each, unlocked in order by clearing the one before. Each map after the first five adds one new idea: a bending lane, an allied radar, a supertanker, single file, lock gates, shore batteries, drifting mines, oil rigs, night, a battleship, fast boats, a fork, two-way traffic, the tide and the Citadel.
acceptance: Menu shows four chapter tabs and the maps in each
Locked maps show a lock
Clearing a map unlocks the next
Each map keeps its best score and wave

features.title: Twelve weapons
features.description: After each wave the player drafts one of three weapons (Flak Cannon, Seeker Pod, Aegis Launchers, Gravity Well, Air Strike, Railgun, Tesla Arc, Shrapnel Shell, Frigate Escort, Thermobaric Shell, Scattergun, Boomerang). Held weapons drop as pickups from kills; tapping one loads the gun with it for 15 seconds. Three held at once, three levels each; level 3 is MAX with a new name.
acceptance: The draft offers three choices after each wave
A weapon pickup loads the gun for 15 s
A held weapon levels up to MAX

features.title: The Armory
features.description: Eleven upgrade cards in three bays (Gun, Hull, Supply), won at random at the end of every run; a duplicate adds a level. Before each run the player equips one card from each bay.
acceptance: Cards won after a run are added to the Armory
One card per bay can be equipped
Cards not won yet are greyed out

features.title: Endless mode
features.description: After clearing a map the run can continue into endless waves that keep growing.
acceptance: The result screen of a clear offers Endless mode
Endless waves grow past wave 10

features.title: Game Center
features.description: A best-score leaderboard for every map and achievements for milestones, through Apple Game Center.
acceptance: Signed-in players post their best score per map
Achievements unlock on the matching events
Playing without Game Center works normally

features.title: Full game unlock
features.description: Chapter 1 (five maps) is free. One non-consumable in-app purchase unlocks chapters 2–4. Settings has Restore Purchases.
acceptance: Chapter 2–4 maps show the unlock offer when tapped without the purchase
The purchase goes through StoreKit
Restore Purchases restores the unlock on a new device

features.title: Settings
features.description: Sound and music volume, haptics on/off, version, credits (CC0 sounds, MIT icons), privacy policy link, Restore Purchases and Reset progress (with a confirmation).
acceptance: Privacy policy link opens the policy
Reset progress asks for confirmation
Version is shown

design.tone: Calm naval command console: dark navy water, cyan radar accents, warm off-white type, red for danger

nativeValue: The complete game is bundled in the app and plays fully offline: nothing is loaded from the network
Game Center leaderboards for every map and achievements
Haptic feedback on kills, hits and wins (Core Haptics via Capacitor Haptics)
Progress saved in native storage (UserDefaults via Capacitor Preferences), so iOS never evicts it
StoreKit in-app purchase with Restore Purchases
Landscape-locked full-screen app with a native launch screen, auto-pause when backgrounded
